At the 2.5 km/s GTO/high-elliptical reference, integrated two-arm mass ratio spans 40.32x at 0% derate, 64.30x at 15% derate, and 121.83x at 30% derate. The 2.8 km/s cislunar revenue-gated option is 295.27x at 30% derate; the 3.5 km/s Mars-class growth option reaches ~3085.95x at 30% derate.
